appDescription: Shimpyo helps drowsy drivers take a short nap at highway drowsiness rest areas by preparing the seat, climate, window and lights, then waking them gently.

function.name: START_REST_BREAK
function.description: Starts a short nap break. When parked it reclines the driver seat and prepares the cabin, and when driving it adds the next drowsiness rest area ahead as a waypoint.

minutes.description: Length of the nap break in minutes, from 10 to 30.

function.name: FIND_REST_AREA
function.description: Finds the next drowsiness rest area ahead in the driving direction and tells its name and distance.

function.name: END_REST_BREAK
function.description: Ends the current nap break, wakes the driver gently and restores the seat, climate, window and lights.
